SELECT AVG(Horsepower) FROM cars_data WHERE Year < 1980

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT T4.Model 
FROM car_makers AS T1 
INNER JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker 
INNER JOIN car_names AS T3 ON T2.Model = T3.Model 
INNER JOIN cars_data AS T4 ON T3.MakeId = T4.Make 
WHERE T1.FullName = 'General Motors' OR T4.Weight > 3500;
```

```sql
SELECT T1.MakeId, T2.Make 
FROM car_names AS T1 
INNER JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Id 
WHERE T2.Horsepower > ( SELECT MIN(Horsepower) FROM cars_data ) 
AND T1.Model IN ( SELECT Model FROM model_list WHERE Maker IN ( SELECT Id FROM car_makers WHERE Cylinders <= 3 ) );
```

```sql
SELECT T1.Id, T1.Maker 
FROM car_makers AS T1 
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker 
JOIN car_names AS T3 ON T2.Model = T3.Model 
GROUP BY T1.Id, T1.Maker 
HAVING COUNT(T2.Model) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT T3.Make) > 3;
```
